scenes.title_cn: 开场：加速的未来与凝固的远古
scenes.title_en: Opening: A Speeding Future & a Frozen Past
scenes.context: 博主开场介绍沙特阿拉伯的两种极端形态：极速旷标（现代文明跳过渡期，沙漠中崛起未来之城）与永恒静默（赤色旷野里巨石砂岩千万年不动）。语域：纪录片旁白，意象丰富。
sentences: 很多人对这里的印象还停留在石油、骆驼的标签里。
Most people still think of this place in terms of oil and camels.
think of ... in terms of（对…的印象停留在）；oil and camels（石油和骆驼的标签）
一种是在沙漠中成长的都市，一跃成为向全世界展露野心的未来之城。
One is a city grown out of the desert, leaping into a future-city that flaunts its ambition to the world.
grow out of the desert（在沙漠中成长）；flaunt ambition（展露野心）
这一站，请和我一起去沙特阿拉伯，看看加速的未来与凝固的远古如何共存。
This stop, come with me to Saudi Arabia to see how a speeding future and a frozen ancient world coexist.
a speeding future（加速的未来）；a frozen ancient world（凝固的远古）
paraphrase: 展露野心 → flaunt ambition / show off its ambition
flaunt ambition · show off ambition
如何共存 → how they coexist / how both can live together
coexist · live together
scenes.speak: Most people still think of this place in terms of oil and camels. One is a city grown out of the desert, leaping into a future-city that flaunts its ambition to the world. This stop, come with me to Saudi Arabia to see how a speeding future and a frozen ancient world coexist.

scenes.title_cn: 王国中心大厦：302米的地标
scenes.context: 博主站在利雅得地标王国中心大厦脚下，介绍它1999年开工、3年建成，是当时利雅得最高建筑，顶部镂空处有「天空之桥」。语域：景点讲解。
sentences: 远远地看过去，它有点像矗立在城市上的一个巨大的开瓶器。
From afar, it looks like a giant bottle opener towering over the city.
a giant bottle opener（巨大的开瓶器）；tower over the city（矗立在城市上）
毕竟它是有302米，1999年开工，02年就完工，三年的时间一跃而起成为利雅得最高的建筑。
It's three hundred and two meters tall — construction started in 1999 and finished in 2002, and in three years it jumped to become the tallest building in Riyadh.
start construction（开工）；become the tallest building（成为最高建筑）
等一下我会走到它的最上面，镂空的位置上面有一个桥，它的名字叫天空之桥。
In a moment I'll go to the top — in the hollowed-out section there's a bridge called the Sky Bridge.
the hollowed-out section（镂空位置）；Sky Bridge（天空之桥）
paraphrase: 像一个开瓶器 → looks like a giant bottle opener / shaped like a bottle opener
bottle opener · shaped like
一跃成为 → jump to become / quickly rose to
jump to become · quickly rose to
scenes.speak: From afar, it looks like a giant bottle opener towering over the city. It's three hundred and two meters tall — construction started in 1999 and finished in 2002, and in three years it jumped to become the tallest building in Riyadh. In a moment I'll go to the top — in the hollowed-out section there's a bridge called the Sky Bridge.

scenes.context: 博主来到利雅得金融中心KAFD，介绍这里汇聚全球十几位顶尖设计师，建筑各具特色；夏季楼与楼之间用遮阳连廊连接，被称为科幻版曼哈顿。语域：城市观察+讲解。
sentences: 这里汇集了来自全球十多位的顶尖设计师，所以我们在观察这些建筑外立面的时候会发现它很独特。
Top designers from around the world were brought together here, which is why the facades look so distinctive.
top designers（顶尖设计师）；facades（外立面）；distinctive（独特）
有人称它为科幻版的曼哈顿。
Some people call it a sci-fi version of Manhattan.
a sci-fi version of（科幻版）
每一栋建筑与建筑之间都有一个连廊连接，从这一栋走到那一栋，走这个遮阳连廊就可以了。
Shaded sky bridges connect the buildings, so you can walk from one to the next under cover.
shaded sky bridges（遮阳连廊）；under cover（在遮蔽下）
paraphrase: 顶尖设计师 → top designers / the world's best architects
top designers · best architects
外立面 → facades / building exteriors
facades · exteriors
scenes.speak: Top designers from around the world were brought together here, which is why the facades look so distinctive. Some people call it a sci-fi version of Manhattan. Shaded sky bridges connect the buildings, so you can walk from one to the next under cover.

scenes.title_cn: 没有圆顶的清真寺：沙漠玫瑰
scenes.title_en: A Mosque Without a Dome: The Desert Rose
scenes.context: 博主介绍金融区里最特别的建筑——没有圆顶的清真寺，设计灵感来自沙特天然矿物「沙漠玫瑰」的结晶体，外观棱角分明。语域：建筑讲解。
sentences: 它是一个清真寺，而且是没有圆顶的清真寺。
It's a mosque — and one without a dome.
without a dome（没有圆顶）
它的设计灵感是来自于沙特当中天然的矿物，叫沙漠玫瑰的结晶体。
Its design is inspired by a natural mineral found in Saudi Arabia — desert rose crystal.
be inspired by（设计灵感来自）；desert rose crystal（沙漠玫瑰结晶体）
这个尖尖的就是宣礼塔，在它的最顶端，有一个非常明显的伊斯兰教的标志，就是一个半月的形状。
That pointed tower is the minaret, and at its very top is the unmistakable symbol of Islam — the crescent.
the minaret（宣礼塔）；the crescent（新月标志）
paraphrase: 设计灵感来自 → inspired by / draws its design from
inspired by · draws from
棱角分明 → sharp-edged / angular
sharp-edged · angular
scenes.speak: It's a mosque — and one without a dome. Its design is inspired by a natural mineral found in Saudi Arabia — desert rose crystal. That pointed tower is the minaret, and at its very top is the unmistakable symbol of Islam — the crescent.

scenes.title_en: Tradition & the Future Side by Side
scenes.context: 博主感慨：身处摩登大楼中间，耳边却环绕着古老的礼拜声；在沙特既有前卫的科技感，又包裹着最核心的信仰。语域：哲思旁白。
sentences: 我觉得它就传递出了一个信号，在沙特这个地方，它既有非常前卫的科技感、未来感，同时它又包裹住了他们最古老最核心的一个点，就是他们的信仰。
I think it sends a signal — Saudi Arabia has a very avant-garde, futuristic feel, and at the same time it holds onto its oldest, most essential core: its faith.
avant-garde（前卫的）；hold onto（包裹住/坚守）；the most essential core（最核心的点）
你身处在如此现代、摩登的大楼中间，但是你耳边环绕的是一种非常传统、非常古老的声音。
You're surrounded by these modern, sleek towers, yet what fills your ears is a very traditional, ancient sound.
modern, sleek towers（现代摩登的大楼）；fill your ears（环绕耳边）
不得不承认，世界真的太奇妙了。
You have to admit — the world is truly amazing.
you have to admit（不得不承认）；truly amazing（真的太奇妙）
paraphrase: 前卫的 → avant-garde / cutting-edge / futuristic
avant-garde · cutting-edge
包裹住信仰 → hold onto its faith / keep faith at its core
hold onto · keep at its core
scenes.speak: I think it sends a signal — Saudi Arabia has a very avant-garde, futuristic feel, and at the same time it holds onto its oldest, most essential core: its faith. You're surrounded by these modern, sleek towers, yet what fills your ears is a very traditional, ancient sound. You have to admit — the world is truly amazing.

scenes.title_en: The Underground Forest: The City's Periscope
scenes.context: 博主介绍利雅得地铁（2024年12月开通，世界上最长的无人驾驶公共交通系统）和地下30米的地铁站，头顶不锈钢顶棚是「城市的潜望镜」。语域：城市发现。
sentences: 谁能想到他们居然把地铁建在了这里，而且在地下打造了一个地下森林。
Who would've thought they'd put a subway here — and build an underground forest beneath the city?
who would've thought（谁能想到）；an underground forest（地下森林）
利亚德的地铁是2024年12月首次开通的线路，但是它完成的是世界上最长的无人驾驶的公共交通系统。
Riyadh's metro opened its first lines in December 2024, and it became the world's longest driverless public transit system.
driverless public transit（无人驾驶公共交通）
我们头上有一个巨大的顶棚，这是不锈钢的顶棚，是城市的潜望镜。
Above us is a huge canopy — a stainless steel canopy that acts as the city's periscope.
a stainless steel canopy（不锈钢顶棚）；the city's periscope（城市的潜望镜）
paraphrase: 谁能想到 → who would've thought / imagine that
who would've thought
无人驾驶 → driverless / self-driving / automated
driverless · self-driving
scenes.speak: Who would've thought they'd put a subway here — and build an underground forest beneath the city? Riyadh's metro opened its first lines in December 2024, and it became the world's longest driverless public transit system. Above us is a huge canopy — a stainless steel canopy that acts as the city's periscope.

scenes.title_cn: 传统集市与哈拉吉拍卖
scenes.context: 博主逛利雅得本地人常逛的集市：传统男装、香料、阿卡尔头箍，还有当地最传统的拍卖市场「哈拉吉」，卖古董小物件。语域：市井观察。
sentences: 这里没有写字楼的精密，只有最原始的买卖和市井的喧嚣。
There's none of the polish of office towers here — only raw trade and the hustle of the streets.
the hustle of the streets（市井的喧嚣）；raw trade（最原始的买卖）
在逛这个传统市集的时候，千万不要忽略我身后的这个地方，这个就是当地最传统的拍卖市场，他们当地叫哈拉吉。
While you browse this traditional souk, don't miss the place behind me — it's the most traditional auction market, called the Haraj.
browse the souk（逛传统市集）；auction market（拍卖市场）
透过这些老物件，我们还能看见阿拉伯人过去的生活方式。
Through these old objects, we can still see how Arabs used to live.
through these old objects（透过老物件）；how people used to live（过去的生活方式）
paraphrase: 市井的喧嚣 → the hustle of the streets / the lively clamor of the market
hustle of the streets · clamor
千万不要忽略 → don't miss / don't overlook
don't miss · don't overlook
scenes.speak: There's none of the polish of office towers here — only raw trade and the hustle of the streets. While you browse this traditional souk, don't miss the place behind me — it's the most traditional auction market, called the Haraj. Through these old objects, we can still see how Arabs used to live.

scenes.title_cn: 黑格拉：纳巴泰人的永恒定居
scenes.context: 博主介绍埃尔奥拉的黑格拉：纳巴泰人从岩石顶部往下凿出的陵墓群，门楣上的乌鸦阶梯通往天国，老鹰是陵墓守护神；越有钱陵墓越大。语域：历史文化讲解。
sentences: 这些巨大陵墓，是纳巴泰人爬上岩石顶部，从上往下一点点凿出来的。
These enormous tombs were carved bit by bit, top-down, by the Nabataeans who climbed the rock.
carve bit by bit（一点点凿出）；top-down（从上往下）
对于当年的纳巴泰人来说，生是短暂的迁徙，死才是永恒的定居。
For the Nabataeans, life was a brief migration, and death was the eternal settlement.
a brief migration（短暂的迁徙）；the eternal settlement（永恒的定居）
门框的最上面有一只老鹰，老鹰相当于是陵墓守护神的作用。
At the top of the doorway sits an eagle, which serves as the tomb's guardian.
the tomb's guardian（陵墓守护神）
paraphrase: 一点点凿出 → carve bit by bit / chisel away little by little
carve bit by bit · chisel away
生与死 → life is a brief migration, death an eternal home
brief migration · eternal home
scenes.speak: These enormous tombs were carved bit by bit, top-down, by the Nabataeans who climbed the rock. For the Nabataeans, life was a brief migration, and death was the eternal settlement. At the top of the doorway sits an eagle, which serves as the tomb's guardian.

scenes.title_cn: 大象岩：大自然的鬼斧神工
scenes.context: 博主来到大象岩区域，完全自然风化的遗迹：两座山紧贴在一起，从洞口望过去是一片绿油油的谷地；几百万年的风沙像一把慢刀反复雕琢。语域：风景描述+哲理。
sentences: 如果说黑格拉是人工的极致，那大象岩所在的区域就是大自然的鬼斧神工。
If Hegra is the pinnacle of human craftsmanship, then Elephant Rock's area is nature's masterpiece.
the pinnacle of human craftsmanship（人工的极致）；nature's masterpiece（鬼斧神工）
几百万年的风沙像一把慢刀，在这片荒野里反复雕琢，直到它呈现出这些极具压迫感的形态。
Millions of years of wind and sand, like a slow blade, carved this wilderness again and again until it took on these imposing forms.
a slow blade（一把慢刀）；imposing forms（极具压迫感的形态）
那些矗立的砂岩，才是永恒的主人。
Those standing sandstones are the true masters of eternity.
the true masters of eternity（永恒的主人）
paraphrase: 鬼斧神工 → nature's masterpiece / the wonders of nature
nature's masterpiece · wonders of nature
反复雕琢 → carved again and again / sculpted over millennia
carved again and again · sculpted over millennia
scenes.speak: If Hegra is the pinnacle of human craftsmanship, then Elephant Rock's area is nature's masterpiece. Millions of years of wind and sand, like a slow blade, carved this wilderness again and again until it took on these imposing forms. Those standing sandstones are the true masters of eternity.

scenes.title_cn: 马拉亚音乐厅：镜面倒映千年
scenes.title_en: Maraya Hall: A Mirror Reflecting a Millennium
scenes.context: 博主介绍吉尼斯认证的世界最大镜面建筑马拉亚音乐厅，镜面覆盖超9000平方米；设计师认为任何建筑都比不上自然的魅力，所以让镜子倒映周围千年的岩石和沙漠。语域：建筑设计+哲思结尾。
sentences: 这个马拉亚音乐厅是吉尼斯认证过的世界上最大的镜面建筑，它上面的镜子覆盖大概超过了9000多平方米。
Maraya Hall is Guinness-certified as the world's largest mirrored building, with mirrors covering over nine thousand square meters.
Guinness-certified（吉尼斯认证）；mirrored building（镜面建筑）
当时的设计师说，任何的建筑物都比不上自然的这种魅力。
The designer said no building can compare with the charm of nature.
nothing can compare with（比不上）；the charm of nature（自然的魅力）
一面是沙特突飞猛进的发展和对未来的野心，另一面永远倒映着一片无法被抹去的古老底色。
On one side, Saudi Arabia's rapid development and ambition for the future; on the other, an ancient undertone that can never be erased.
rapid development（突飞猛进）；an ancient undertone（古老底色）
paraphrase: 比不上 → can't compare with / no match for
can't compare · no match for
古老底色 → an ancient undertone / an age-old backdrop
ancient undertone · age-old backdrop
scenes.speak: Maraya Hall is Guinness-certified as the world's largest mirrored building, with mirrors covering over nine thousand square meters. The designer said no building can compare with the charm of nature. On one side, Saudi Arabia's rapid development and ambition for the future; on the other, an ancient undertone that can never be erased.

practice: 介绍利雅得的快速发展
Riyadh rose from a mud-brick town to a futuristic city in just a few decades.
描述无圆顶清真寺的设计
The dome-less mosque was inspired by desert rose crystal.
The Nabataeans carved these tombs top-down from the rock.
Maraya Hall is the world's largest mirrored building, reflecting the ancient rocks around it.
pitfalls: The mosque was designed without a dome.
「没有圆顶」是 without a dome / dome-less，不是 no top。
These tombs were carved bit by bit by the Nabataeans.
说明建造方式（carve bit by bit）比只说 old 更有历史信息。
The mirrored facade reflects the surrounding rocks and desert.
主语应是建筑立面（facade），reflect 后面要有宾语（倒映什么）。
Saudi Arabia blends cutting-edge modernity with its ancient faith.
blends A with B 表达「共存」比 very modern 更精准。
shifts: 说城市发展只会 develop fast
用 leap into（一跃成为）、rapid development、transformed from mud-brick to futuristic
用 mirrored facade（镜面）、dome-less（无圆顶）、avant-garde（前卫）、sandstone（砂岩）
用 Guinness-certified（吉尼斯认证）、unmistakable（不容置疑）、imposing（震撼）
